facts.fact: The CGIX portal, run with the regulator ARPCE, reports the Congo internet exchange point in operation with 4 connected members and 1 point of presence; the page is undated and the year 2022 is inferred from its own '9 years of existence' counter.
Traffic: 70 Mb/s (stated per hour, peak or average not given) at CGIX on 2022 (undated portal counter, year inferred), as stated by the CGIX portal.

systems.owner: ARPCE with Airtel and MTN on its board

note: Launched May 2013 with 7 operators and chosen by the African Union in August 2017 as Central Africa sub-regional hub (both stated on the portal); no content network, growth figures or second city stated.
